about: Every kind you could own (docs/VISION.md: homes, the mall, the VIP shop read this). Prices are in credits (valued like the dollar). Only a small set is tradeable, on purpose. tools/native/bar_world_test.cpp checks each item is a real kind.

items.name: Table candle
items.about: A candle for a table: it flickers, and you can blow it out.

items.name: Table stool
items.about: A round stool for a high table.

items.name: Bar stool
items.about: A swivel stool with a padded seat.

items.name: Chalkboard
items.about: A chalkboard on a nail; knock it and it swings.

items.name: Pendant lamp
items.about: A lamp that hangs from the ceiling and sways.

items.name: High table
items.about: A round high table that rocks a hair on an uneven floor.

items.name: Jukebox
items.about: Plays the songs; thumps on the beat. Tradeable.

items.name: Arcade machine
items.about: An arcade machine with the platformer. Tradeable.

items.name: Racing rig
items.about: A racing seat with a wheel and screens.

items.name: Grand piano
items.about: A grand piano: play its songs or your own.
